index_basis: 1.00 multiplies the existing baseline after applicable regional, quality and seasonal adjustments; it does not replace those adjustments.
review_policy: Review after meaningful economic events or an elapsed story year. No preset annual inflation. Record date, geography, category, old/new index, cause, status and replaced modifiers. Preserve past transactions and fixed contract terms; distinguish real output from nominal prices.
